Garage Gym Ideas

Start with a squat rack, barbell, plates and an adjustable bench on rubber flooring along one wall. That covers squats, presses, deadlifts and rows, which train every major muscle group the CDC recommends working at least twice a week. Add conditioning and recovery gear only after the basics are paid off.

Swipe for the details. The full guide, with every source linked, is at the link in bio.
